```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: perf-benchmark-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: pr

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies (PR)
        working-directory: pr
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build (PR)
        working-directory: pr
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests (PR)
        working-directory: pr
        run: npm run test

      - name: Run lint (PR)
        working-directory: pr
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Install dependencies (main)
        working-directory: main
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build (main)
        working-directory: main
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run benchmark
        id: benchmark
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          run_bench() {
            local dir=$1
            local label=$2
            local times=()
            for i in {1..7}; do
              if [ $i -le 2 ]; then
                echo "Warmup $i for $label"
                time -p npx repomix pack . > /dev/null 2>&1
              else
                echo "Measured $i for $label"
                t=$( { time -p npx repomix pack . > /dev/null 2>&1; } 2>&1 | grep real | awk '{print $2}' )
                times+=("$t")
              fi
            done
            IFS=$'\n' sorted=($(sort -n <<<"${times[*]}"))
            median=${sorted[${#sorted[@]}/2]}
            echo "${label}=${median}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          }
          run_bench pr "PR branch"
          run_bench main "main branch"

      - name: Calculate diff
        id: diff
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pr_time=$(echo "${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.PR branch }}" | awk -F= '{print $2}')
          main_time=$(echo "${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.main branch }}" | awk -F= '{print $2}')
          diff=$(echo "$pr_time - $main_time" | bc -l)
          percent=$(echo "scale=4; ($diff / $main_time) * 100" | bc -l)
          diff=$(printf '%+.2f' "$diff")
          percent=$(printf '%+.1f' "$percent")
          echo "pr_time=$pr_time" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "main_time=$main_time" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "diff=$diff" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "percent=$percent" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post benchmark comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          PR_TIME: ${{ steps.diff.outputs.pr_time }}
          MAIN_TIME: ${{ steps.diff.outputs.main_time }}
          DIFF: ${{ steps.diff.outputs.diff }}
          PERCENT: ${{ steps.diff.outputs.percent }}
        with:
          script: |
            const marker = '<!-- perf-benchmark -->';
            const body = `${marker}
| | Time |
|---|---:|
| PR branch | ${process.env.PR_TIME}s |
| main branch | ${process.env.MAIN_TIME}s |
| **Diff** | **${process.env.DIFF}s (${process.env.PERCENT}%)** |
`;
            const { data: comments } = await github.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: Number(process.env.PR_NUMBER),
            });
            const existing = comments.find(c => c.body.includes(marker));
            if (existing) {
              await github.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: existing.id,
                body,
              });
            } else {
              await github.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: Number(process.env.PR_NUMBER),
                body,
              });
            }
```
